title: Multiple writestream to same delta table error
question:
I am trying to run 2 spark structured streaming jobs in databricks. Each job is running on it's own job cluster and streaming data from different AWS Kinesis data stream but both the jobs are writing data to same delta table. Both the jobs have different checkpoint location.

While running these jobs, I am getting this error:

io.delta.exceptions.MetadataChangedException: [DELTA_METADATA_CHANGED] MetadataChangedException: The metadata of the Delta table has been changed by a concurrent update. Please try the operation again.

It looks like concurrency issue but I thought that multiple writers could write to delta table without any issue. Could someone please help me with this issue? Thanks
answer:
You can have multiple streams updating the same Delta table only with proper isolation.
The streams should not be modifying the same partition, this will lead to concurrent modification errors.

Ensure that each stream is exclusive in modifying its target partitions.
EG: If partitioned by date/hour, only one stream should be modifying (date: 2025-07-30/hour: 1) at a time.

This can be accomplished by applying partition filters to the update operation:

UPDATE table WHERE (date = '2025-07-30' AND hour = 1)

See partition isolation in Databricks documentation.

UPDATE: If no partitioning on table you can enable row-level concurrency, however there may be conflicts if multiple streams are preforming UPDATE, DELETE, MERGE INTO operations

Note that you must have deletion vectors enabled:

"Tables do not support row-level concurrency if they have partitions defined or do not have deletion vectors enabled. Databricks Runtime 14.2 or above is required for row-level concurrency."

ALTER TABLE table_name SET TBLPROPERTIES ('delta.enableDeletionVectors' = true);

See documentation for row-level concurrency
See documentation for limitations of row-level concurrency
